result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on a Legendre-type transformation of a function of x,y,z depending on p^2+q^2+r^2, its second derivatives and Hessian-type invariants, with determination of an auxiliary function ψ(m) and of conditions on a function χ, plus a side note on the eikonal equation (∂f/∂x)^2+(∂f/∂y)^2+(∂f/∂z)^2 = const.
result.transcription:
[-$\rho = \varphi$-] \quad $\rho = \varphi(\ldots)$ \quad $\left(\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial y}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial z}\right)^2 = A$ = const.
$\rho - x\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial y} - z\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial z} = \sigma$ \quad [-$\rho = \alpha x$-]
$\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial x} = p$ \quad $\frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial p} = -x$ \quad $-dx = \frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p^2}dp + \frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p \partial q}$ \quad $\rho = f(x+yi) + \varphi(x-yi)$
$\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial y} = q$ \quad $\frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial q} = -y$
$\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial z} = r$ \quad $\frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial r} = -z$
$\rho = \sigma - \frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial p}p - \frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial q}q - \frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial r}r = \varphi(p^2+q^2+r^2)$
$\psi(m) = \frac{1}{m^{\frac12}}$ \quad $\psi(m) = m^{\frac12}$ \quad $\varphi(m) = 0$
$\sigma = \psi(m)$
$\psi(m) - 2m\psi'(m) = \varphi(m)$
$\sigma = \psi(m) + p\,\chi\left(\frac{q}{p}, \frac{r}{p}\right)$
$\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial r^2} - \left(\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial q \partial r}\right)^2 + \frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p^2}\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial r^2} - \left(\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p \partial r}\right)^2 + \frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p^2}\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial q^2} - \left(\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p \partial q}\right)^2 = \frac{\partial^2 \rho}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 \rho}{\partial y^2} + \frac{\partial^2 \rho}{\partial z^2}$
$\frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial p} = \psi'(m)\,2p + \chi - \alpha\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial \alpha} - \beta\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial \beta}$ \quad $8\psi'(m)^3 + 16\psi'(m)^2\psi''(m)m$
$\frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial q} = \psi'(m)\,2q + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial \alpha}$
$\frac{\partial \sigma}{\partial r} = \psi'(m)\,2r + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial \beta}$
$\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p^2} = 2\psi'(m) + \psi''(m)\,4p^2 + \left(\alpha^2\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2} + 2\alpha\beta\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} + \beta^2\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2}\right)\frac{1}{p}$
$\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial p \partial q} = 4\psi''(m)\,pq - \left(\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2}\alpha + \frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta}\beta\right)\frac{1}{p}$
$\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial q^2} = 2\psi'(m) + \psi''(m)\,4q^2 + \frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2}\frac{1}{p}$
$\frac{\partial^2 \sigma}{\partial q \partial r} = 4\psi''(m)\,qr + \frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta}\frac{1}{p}$
$4\psi'(m)^2 + 8\psi'(m)\psi''(m)(p^2+q^2) + 2\psi'(m)\left((\alpha^2+1)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2} + 2\alpha\beta\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} + \beta^2\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2}\right)\frac{1}{p} + 4p\psi''(m)\left(\ldots\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2} + (\alpha^2+1)2\alpha\beta\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} + \beta^2\alpha^2\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2}\right)$
$4\psi'(m)^2 + 8\psi'(m)\psi''(m)(p^2+r^2) + 2\psi'(m)\frac{1}{p}\left(\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2} + \frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2}\right) + 4p\psi''(m)\left(\beta^2\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2} + \alpha^2\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2} - 2\alpha\beta\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta}\right)$
$4\psi'(m)^2 + 16\psi'(m)\psi''(m)\,m + (4\psi'(m) + 4\psi''(m)m)\frac{1}{p}\left((\alpha^2+1)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2} + 2\alpha\beta\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} + (\beta^2+1)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2}\right) + \frac{1}{p^2}(\beta^2+\alpha^2+1)\left(\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2}\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2} - \frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta}^2\right)$
$\psi'(m) + 4\psi''(m)m = k\,[-\psi'(m)-]\left(4 + 4\frac{\psi''(m)}{\psi'(m)}m\right)\frac{1}{m^{\frac12}}$ \quad $\alpha p - m$ \quad $\alpha^2 p^2$
$(\alpha^2+1)\lambda + \alpha\beta = \pm\sqrt{-\alpha^2-\beta^2-1}$ \quad $\alpha p + m$
$\psi'(m) + \psi''(m)m = \frac{k_1}{m^{\frac12}}$ \quad $qp - r^2 = 0$
$\left(\lambda\frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \beta} - \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \alpha}\right)\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} = 0$ \quad $\frac{p}{r} = \lambda$ \quad $\frac{q}{r} = \frac{1}{\lambda}$
$m\psi'(m) = 2k_1 m^{\frac12} + k_2$ \quad [-$k_2 = 0$-]
$\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2} + \lambda\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} = 0$ \quad $\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} + \lambda\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} + \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \beta}\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} = 0$
$\psi'(m) = 2k_1 m^{-\frac12} + \frac{k_2}{m}$
$\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2} + \frac{1}{\lambda}\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} = 0$ \quad $\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta \partial \alpha} + \frac{1}{\lambda}\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} - \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \alpha}\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta} = 0$
$\psi''(m)m = -\frac{k_1}{m^{\frac12}} - \frac{k_2}{m}$
$(\alpha^2+1)\frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \beta} = \alpha + \frac{\beta}{m}$
$\psi'(m) + 4\psi''(m)m = -\frac{2k_1}{m^{\frac12}} - \frac{3k_2}{m}$ \quad $-(\beta^2+1)\frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial \alpha}\frac{1}{\lambda^2} = \beta - \frac{\alpha}{m}$
$\cdot m^{\frac12} = -2k_1 - 3k_2 m^{-\frac12}$ \quad $p(\alpha^2 p + 2\alpha\beta r + \beta^2 q) - (\alpha p + \beta r)^2$
$k_2 = 0$ \quad $\frac{\alpha}{\alpha^2+1} - \frac{\beta}{\beta^2+1}\lambda + \ldots = 0$ \quad $\beta^2(qp - r^2)$
$\lambda = \frac{\alpha\beta + m}{\alpha^2+1}$ \quad $\alpha^2(qp - r^2)$
$-2k_1 = k(4-2)$ \quad $(\beta^2+\alpha^2+1)$
$-k_1 = k$
$2\psi' m(\delta p^2 + \delta q^2 + \delta r^2) + \psi''(m)(p\delta p + q\delta q + r\delta r)^2 + \frac{1}{p}\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha^2}(\delta q - \alpha\delta p)^2 + 2\frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \alpha \partial \beta}(\delta q - \alpha\delta p)(\delta r - \beta\delta p) + \frac{\partial^2 \chi}{\partial \beta^2}(\delta r - \beta\delta p)^2$
$\left(\alpha + \frac{\beta}{m}\right) - (\alpha^2+1)\lambda\frac{\left(\beta + \frac{\alpha}{m}\right)}{\beta^2+1} = \ldots m^2 - (\alpha^2+1)(\beta^2+1)$ \quad $\rho = s + t$ \quad $\log\varphi(\rho) = a(s+t) + b$
$\delta q = t + \alpha\delta p$ \quad $\left(\frac{\partial s}{\partial z}\right) = \frac{\partial t}{\partial z'}$
$\delta r = u + \beta\delta p$ \quad [-$\log f(s) + \log f(t)$-]
$-\frac{\beta}{m} - \frac{\alpha^2\beta}{m} + \frac{\beta m}{\beta^2+1} \ldots = 0$ \quad $\delta m = 2(qt + ru) + (p + q\alpha + r\beta)\delta p$ \quad $\varphi z = c\,e^{as} + c$
$\alpha(\beta^2+1)$ \quad $z' = c\,e^{at} + c$
$\varphi(\rho) = \chi(s+t)$ \quad $a(s+t) + b$
$\log\frac{\partial s}{\partial z} = as$ \quad $\log\frac{\partial t}{\partial z'} = at$

Sum of principal 2x2 minors of Hessian of σ related to Laplacian of ρ
